difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: in the situation of the lemma there is a canonical isomorphism L_{X/Lambda} = Lpi_!(Li^*Omega_{O/Lambda}) = Lpi_!(i^*Omega_{O/Lambda}) = Lpi_!(Omega_{O/Lambda} tensor O_X) in D(O_X) (source lines 4340-4351). The proof is parallel to the algebraic-space version but uses the scheme-side remarks: it observes that the value of the sheaf O on any object of the category is a polynomial algebra over Lambda, so the module of differentials is flat and the last two equalities hold; then it uses the computation remark to express the lower shriek as the sheafification of the presheaf U -> Omega_{P_bullet,U/Lambda} tensor O_X(U) = L_{O_X(U)/Lambda}, the section-level remark to identify this as the cotangent complex of the ring map Lambda -> O_X on X, and the scheme-over-ring lemma to conclude.
